goals.2: The four parts of the exam: Lesen, Hören, Schreiben, Sprechen
dialog.1.de.3.n: um … zu + infinitive = purpose (in order to …)
dialog.2.de.4.n: damit = so that (subordinate clause, verb at the end)
grammar.0.note: um … zu = “in order to …”. damit = “so that”. When the subjects differ, use only damit.
grammar.1.title: um … zu: infinitive at the end
grammar.1.text: The um phrase is separated by a comma. zu + infinitive goes right at the end.
grammar.2.title: Goethe-Zertifikat: four parts
grammar.2.note: The exam and its dates change from time to time — check the Goethe-Institut or Telc website.
grammar.2.rows.0.2: read short texts and answer questions
grammar.2.rows.1.2: listen to announcements or conversations and answer
grammar.2.rows.2.2: write a short email or message
grammar.2.rows.3.2: talk about yourself, ask questions, discuss
quiz.6.why: damit clause: verb at the end.
